title: 第25章 杀手求追读求收藏求月票推荐票第26章 反击求追读求收藏求月票推荐票
content_zh:
嘶吼声、喊杀声、哭爹喊娘声充斥着整片山林。
几乎所有人都在为了前途、银子、自己的性命而拼命厮杀。
最吸引人注意力的，自然是黑龙寨大当家和魏勇夫的搏命厮杀。
至于苏牧，根本没有人注意他。
这算是，天赐良机？
苏牧看着在他脚下蠕动的邢兆福。
就是这么巧，被黑龙寨大当家一脚踢飞的邢兆福，正巧落在了他的面前。
原本就有伤在身的邢兆福，被黑龙寨大当家势大力沉的一脚直接给踢残了。
“救——救我！”
邢兆福看着苏牧，喉咙间发出含糊不清的求救声。
苏牧侧身避开背后一个匪徒的偷袭，长刀顺势斩掉了对方半拉脖子，血水如瀑溅到了他的身上。
苏牧不躲不闪，任由鲜血洒在身上。
带着满身的血腥气，他在邢兆福身前蹲了下了。
“邢捕头，杀人者，人恒杀之，下辈子记得做个好人。”
他用只有两人能听到的声音小声道。
邢兆福眼睛猛地瞪大，瞳孔之中充满了惊恐之色。
“你——”
他还想说话，一只手已经捂住了他的嘴巴。
噗！
刀锋从邢兆福的腹部捅了进去。

邢兆福身体猛地一蹬，鲜血从苏牧手指缝间流淌而出。
然后他的身子就渐渐地软了下去，眼中的光芒渐渐消失不见。
苏牧没有注意到，就在他杀死邢兆福的时候，远处，一个人悄悄将手中的弓箭移开。
那人正是杨锦。
如果苏牧不动手，杨锦也不会放过这种天赐良机。
不过那样的话，他就要重新评估苏牧的价值了。
幸好，苏牧不是那种绵软的老好人。
杨锦眼神一闪，唰的一下松开了弓弦，箭矢直奔黑龙寨大当家而去。
苏牧有些嫌弃地在邢兆福的尸体上抹了两把，擦去手上的鲜血，顺势将邢兆福怀里的一个小小的绸布包裹揣进了自己怀里。
然后他才抬起头，看向那黑龙寨的大当家。
这一看不要紧，他顿时就被吓了一跳。
那个魏勇夫，浑身鲜血，眼神涣散，招式都已经乱了，被那黑龙寨的大当家打得步步倒退。
那黑龙寨的大当家状若神魔，皮肤表面竟然浮现出大片的诡异花纹。
他每一下攻击，魏勇夫身上都被带起大片的鲜血，那些鲜血，诡异的被黑龙寨大当家身上的花纹给吸收进去。
content_en:
Screams, shouts of death, and cries for father and mother filled the entire forest.
Almost everyone is fighting desperately for their future, money, and their own lives.
What attracts the most attention is naturally the desperate fight between the head of the Black Dragon Village and Wei Yongfu.
As for Su Mu, no one paid attention to him at all.
Is this a God-sent opportunity?
Su Mu looked at Xing Zhaofu squirming under his feet.
It was such a coincidence that Xing Zhaofu, who had been kicked away by the head of Black Dragon Village, happened to land in front of him.
Xing Zhaofu, who was originally injured, was severely kicked by the leader of Black Dragon Village and was disabled.
"S-save me!"
Xing Zhaofu looked at Su Mu and made a vague cry for help in his throat.
Su Mu turned sideways to avoid the sneak attack of a gangster behind him, and cut off half of the gangster's neck with his long knife, and blood splashed on his body like a waterfall.
Su Mu refused to dodge and let the blood spill on his body.
With the smell of blood all over his body, he squatted down in front of Xing Zhaofu.
"Xing arrests the head and kills the murderer. Remember to be a good person in the next life."
He whispered in a voice that only the two of them could hear.
Xing Zhaofu's eyes suddenly widened, his pupils filled with fear.
"You——"
He still wanted to speak, but a hand covered his mouth.
puff!
The blade penetrated Xing Zhaofu's abdomen.
Xing Zhaofu kicked his body violently, and blood flowed from between Su Mu's fingers.
Then his body gradually softened, and the light in his eyes gradually disappeared.
Su Mu didn't notice that just as he was killing Xing Zhaofu, in the distance, a man quietly removed the bow and arrow in his hand.
That person is Yang Jin.
If Su Mu didn't take action, Yang Jin would not let go of this God-given opportunity.
But in that case, he would have to re-evaluate Su Mu's value.
Fortunately, Su Mu is not that kind of soft-hearted good guy.
Yang Jin's eyes flashed, and he loosened the bow string with a snap, and the arrow went straight towards the head of the Black Dragon Village.
Su Mu wiped Xing Zhaofu's body with some disgust, wiped off the blood on his hands, and put a small silk parcel in Xing Zhaofu's arms into his arms.
Then he raised his head and looked at the head of the Black Dragon Village.
It didn't matter what he saw, he was immediately startled.
That Wei Yongfu, covered in blood, his eyes blurry, and his moves messed up, was beaten back step by step by the head of the Black Dragon Village.
The head of the Black Dragon Village looked like a god and demon, with large strange patterns appearing on his skin.
With every attack he made, a large amount of blood was brought up from Wei Yongfu's body. The blood was strangely absorbed by the patterns on the head of the Black Dragon Village.
